items.exampleEn: Many people here commute more than an hour each way.
items.exampleZh: 這裡很多人單程通勤超過一小時。

items.exampleEn: The foreman gave each worker a list of tasks.
items.exampleZh: 領班給每位工人一張工作清單。

items.exampleEn: Attendance at the morning meeting is required.
items.exampleZh: 早上的會議一定要出席。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather worked as a laborer on construction sites.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺以前在工地當工人。

items.exampleEn: The farmers toil in the fields from morning till night.
items.exampleZh: 農夫們從早到晚在田裡辛苦工作。

items.exampleEn: The manager called every absentee to ask why they missed work.
items.exampleZh: 經理打電話給每位缺席者，問他們為什麼沒來上班。

items.exampleEn: He keeps all his tools on the workbench in the garage.
items.exampleZh: 他把所有工具都放在車庫的工作台上。

items.exampleEn: My mother makes dresses on a large worktable in her room.
items.exampleZh: 我媽媽在她房間裡的一張大工作桌上做洋裝。

items.exampleEn: Carpools help reduce traffic in the city center.
items.exampleZh: 共乘有助於減少市中心的車流。

items.sentenceEn: Attendance at work has improved since the company started a carpool program.
items.sentenceZh: 自從公司推出共乘計畫，員工出勤狀況改善了。

items.audioEn: I usually commute by bus, but on Fridays I join a carpool with my neighbors.
items.audioZh: 我平常搭公車通勤，但星期五我會和鄰居共乘。
items.questionZh: 說話者星期五怎麼上班？
options: Rides a bike to the office

items.sentenceEn: Many parents toil for years so their children can go to college.
items.sentenceZh: 許多父母辛苦工作好多年，讓孩子能上大學。

items.sentenceEn: Please clean your worktable before you go home.
items.sentenceZh: 回家前請把你的工作桌清乾淨。

items.stemEn: The ____ told us to start work at seven and finish by four.
items.stemZh: 領班要我們七點開工、四點前收工。

items.stemEn: It takes me an hour to ____ to the city center every day.
items.stemZh: 我每天通勤到市中心要花一個小時。

items.passageEn: Every morning at six, Mr. Huang leaves home to commute to the furniture factory where he works as a foreman. He carpools with two laborers who live nearby. At the factory, he first checks attendance and writes down the name of any absentee. Then he walks around to make sure every workbench is clean and every tool is in its place. The work is hard; the men toil for hours, cutting and shaping wood. In the afternoon, Mr. Huang sits at his worktable to plan the next day's jobs. He gets home at six, tired but proud.
items.passageZh: 每天早上六點，黃先生出門通勤到他擔任領班的傢俱工廠。他和兩位住在附近的工人一起共乘。到了工廠，他先點名，記下缺席者的名字。接著他到處巡視，確認每張工作台都乾淨、每件工具都放回原位。這份工作很辛苦，工人們一連幾個小時切割、加工木頭。下午，黃先生坐在他的工作桌前，規劃隔天的工作。他六點回到家，雖然累，卻很自豪。

questions.questionZh: 黃先生到工廠後第一件事做什麼？
options: 坐下來規劃隔天的工作
每天早上自己一個人開車去
和兩位住附近的工人共乘
搭每天經過工廠附近的公車

items.promptZh: 我每天搭火車通勤，大約要四十分鐘。
referenceEn: I commute by train every day, and it takes about forty minutes.
My daily commute by train takes about forty minutes.
rubricZh: commute 可當動詞（例如 I commute by train）或名詞（例如 my daily commute）
「大約要四十分鐘」可寫 it takes about forty minutes、takes around forty minutes 等

items.promptZh: 這門課的出席佔總成績的百分之十。
referenceEn: Attendance counts for ten percent of the final grade in this course.
In this course, attendance is ten percent of the final grade.
rubricZh: attendance 指出席情況，可當主詞（例如 Attendance counts for… 等）
「佔…百分之十」可寫，例如 counts for ten percent of、is ten percent of、makes up 10% of 等
「總成績」可寫，例如 the final grade、the total grade、the final mark 等
